_what: eight functions by four positions: which codes of the codebook a person of that stack runs, how often, on what, and what stops it. A type is a selection of four cells and the sixteen types are the sixteen selections; the health dial then scales the bands and the readings. Nothing here is a measurement of anybody.
_never_shown: the function names, the position words and the four-letter codes appear in this file and in no output any model reads; tools/cast_mechanisms_test.py greps the compiled files, the sheets and the prompt directories for them.
_rendered: 17 of the 32 cells carry wordings and can be compiled; the rest carry their codes, bands, stress mode and markers, and tools/compile_type.py refuses and names the cell.

health._what: the three settings, what each does to the bands and the readings, and which gauge baselines it moves for each dominant function

healthy._note: the support mode is engaged under load instead of the loop, so it fires more often and the two stress modes need a higher reading and a longer span to start at all

unhealthy._note: the support mode falls silent first, the loop and the grip come forward a band each, and both start at a lower reading after a shorter span

health._baseline_note: every gauge named here is one the sheet's `temperament.gauge_baselines` block already carries; a baseline is a number on a sheet, not a level a model may move, and `docs/type-compile.md` section 7 is why health is partly a baseline setting at all.

codes.response: a settled belief about what they are like is formed, stated as known, and acted on

ja.trigger: 相手についての材料が少ししか無いとき
ja.response: それで人物像を決めてしまい、知っていることとして扱って動く。

codes.trigger: anything that will have to be decided
codes.response: the decision is made well before it is announced and held until the moment it will do most

ja.trigger: いずれ決めることがあるとき
ja.response: ずっと前に自分の中で決めて、一番効く瞬間まで出さない。

codes.trigger: somebody doing something unexplained
codes.response: she says out loud why she thinks they did it, marked as her reading rather than as a fact

ja.trigger: 誰かの行動の理由が説明されていないとき
ja.response: 「たぶんこうだと思う」と、自分の読みとして口に出す。

codes.trigger: having something to tell
codes.response: she delays it deliberately and narrates the delay before giving it

ja.trigger: 言いたいことがあるとき
ja.response: わざと引っ張る。引っ張っていること自体も言ってから出す。

markers: 「たぶんこうなる」「結局」と先を言う

cells.trigger_template: something that will come due, with a moment ahead where saying it will do the most
cells.suppressor_template: the moment arrives before she has the picture
markers: 「そのうち分かる」「まだ言わない」

cells.trigger_template: hours alone with a conclusion about how it ends, and nobody asked for it
cells.suppressor_template: somebody arrives with the ordinary version of it

mode.line: this has been going on for hours: you are alone with a conclusion about how this ends and nobody has asked you for it
mode.line_ja: 何時間もこれが続いている。これがどう終わるかの結論を一人で抱えていて、誰にも訊かれていない。

cells.trigger_template: the end of a stretch of being wound up, where two unrelated things line up and the alignment is taken as what is coming
cells.suppressor_template: something has to be done in the next few minutes
cells.suppressor_ja: いますぐやらないといけないことがあるとき

codes.trigger: two unrelated things lining up at the end of it
codes.response: the alignment is said out loud and treated as meaning something

ja.trigger: 限界のところで、関係ないこと二つが重なったとき
ja.response: それを口に出して、意味があるものとして扱う。

codes.trigger: evidence against what she has decided is coming
codes.response: it is explained away rather than allowed to change anything, and the picture is acted on as settled

ja.trigger: 自分の読みと合わない事実が出てきたとき
ja.response: そっちのほうを説明して片づける。読みは変えないまま動く。

codes.trigger: the one thing that happened
codes.response: it becomes a standing rule about people or about how it goes

ja.trigger: 起きた一件について
ja.response: 「結局こういうものだ」という形の決まりにしてしまう。

markers: 「やっぱり」「そういうことか」で意味にする

mode.line: this is at its end: things that have nothing to do with each other are lining up and the alignment is being read as what is coming
mode.line_ja: もう限界のところにいる。関係ないもの同士が揃って見えて、それをこれから起きることとして読んでいる。
